subject: Map: Data handling & compliance (MAP milestone) - follow-up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP follow-up: Data handling & compliance (post-call recap)

Hi Sara / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed MAP milestone around data handling & compliance so we can lock responsibilities and target dates: 

Summary of ask (from FinHealth):
- Clarify PHI/PII handling and whether PHI can be processed/stored in Redwood-hosted environments.
- Retention policies for request logs and model outputs (audit requirements).
- Audit trail / export capability and encryption / KMS controls.
- BAA / HIPAA coverage and SOC 2 evidence.

Proposed MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (owner / target dates / dependencies)
- Milestone name: "Compliance sign-off: Data handling & retention"
- Owner (Redwood): Aditya Rao (Sales) + Marissa Cole (Security/Privacy)
- Owner (FinHealth): Sara Thompson (Security) + Michael Lee (Platform)
- Target close date: 2027-01-15 (proposed)
- Deliverables / acceptance criteria: BAA agreed, retention & logging policy documented, security questionnaire baseline answered, plan for PHI segregation (if required) defined.
- Dependencies: Legal review (both sides), security questionnaire responses, decision on Private deployment vs Dedicated with VPC and KMS.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether PHI will be required to be stored long-term in production (and if so, any minimum retention timeframe regulatory requirement on your side)?
2) Please confirm preferred owner(s) and acceptance criteria above — I attached a first-pass MAP_Draft_v1.pdf for comment.
3) If you have an existing security requirements spreadsheet, please share so we can map responses.

Attachments: MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP milestone + responsibilities)

I propose we target a follow-up in ~1 week after you share the security worksheet so our security/engineering team can scope the deployment pattern.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
From: Sara Thompson <sara@finhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@finhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP follow-up: Data handling & compliance (post-call recap)

Thanks, Aditya — good summary and appreciate the MAP draft. Attaching our security requirements spreadsheet (FinHealth_Security_Reqs.xlsx). A few clarifications from our side: 

- PHI: Yes, our platform does surface PHI in some workflows. For production we require that PHI be stored only in customer-managed or segregated environments. Can Redwood guarantee that PHI will not be persisted in shared-hosted model outputs? If not, we need Private deployment or Dedicated with strict data isolation.
- Retention: Regulatory teams ask for audit logs retained for up to 7 years in some cases. For model outputs / transcripts we typically retain 7 years unless redaction is possible.
- Audit trails: We need immutable request/response logs with export capability (S3) and time-indexed audit events.
- Encryption / KMS: All keys must be customer-managed (bring-your-own-key) for production PHI.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report and prior BAA template would be helpful.

We'll review your MAP draft and mark fields in the spreadsheet. Proposed timeline: security worksheet back to you by 2026-11-24.

Sara Thompson
Security Lead, FinHealth
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP follow-up: Data handling & compliance (post-call recap)

Sara — thanks for the quick clarification and the spreadsheet. A few points to be explicit about Redwood's supported approaches and the MAP adjustments we recommend: 

Redwood capabilities (summary):
- PHI handling: We support three deployment patterns: Hosted (shared), Dedicated (customer-dedicated GPU pools), and Private (VPC / on-prem). For workloads requiring PHI persistence, we recommend Private or Dedicated with VPC + customer-managed KMS. In Hosted, we do not persist user-level outputs by default unless configured — but PHI-sensitive workloads should be on Dedicated/Private.
- Retention/logging: Request logs and model telemetry are configurable. Default retention is 365 days for request logs; we can provide long-term export/archival to your S3 for >365 days (including multi-year export for audit).
- Audit trails: Immutable audit events can be exported to S3 with timestamped files. We can also provide a searchable logs export via our Console for 1 year; longer-term archival would be an export.
- Encryption: Support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and HSM integration for Private deployments.
- Evidence: We'll share our SOC 2 Type II summary and an initial BAA template.

Updated MAP milestones / responsibilities (suggested):
- Security questionnaire completed (owner: FinHealth — due 2026-11-24) [dependency: FinHealth worksheet]
- BAA draft exchanged (owner: Redwood legal + FinHealth legal — Redwood to send initial draft by 2026-11-30)
- Technical design for PHI segregation (owner: Dev Patel / FinHealth platform — draft due 2026-12-15)
- Export/retention runbook (owner: Redwood infra — ready for review 2026-12-22)
- Compliance sign-off (both parties) — target close 2027-01-15

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (high-level controls + KMS options)

Next steps from Redwood:
1) I will share SOC 2 summary + BAA draft by 2026-11-30.
2) Dev (cc'd) will start a short tech note on options for PHI segregation and export paths.
3) Let's tentatively schedule a technical deep-dive week of 2026-12-06 — will propose times after we see your worksheet.

Do these milestones look OK to you? If FinHealth needs the 7-year retention formalized in the MAP, we can add an archival/export milestone explicitly.

Cheers,
Aditya
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara@finhealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP follow-up: Data handling & compliance (post-call recap)

Hi Sara / team — looping in Redwood security & engineering to tee up the technical deep-dive. A few operational notes from our side: 

- We can confirm Redwood is prepared to sign a standard BAA for customers processing PHI; legal will share a draft for review by 2026-12-08.
- For the 7-year audit log requirement: our recommended approach is to export immutable logs daily into your S3 bucket (we will provide verification hashes). That export milestone will be added to the MAP as "Archive & attestation" with owner: Redwood infra (Dev) and FinHealth platform to provide S3 endpoint and IAM role permissions. Target for that milestone: 2026-12-22 (ready for trial export) with final sign-off 2027-01-15.
- Dev will prepare a short design doc comparing Dedicated vs Private for PHI use-cases and the operational tradeoffs.

Action items / next owners: 
- FinHealth: complete security spreadsheet -> due 2026-11-24 (Sara)
- Redwood: send BAA draft -> due 2026-11-30 (Marissa / Legal)
- Redwood infra: design doc + export runbook -> draft due 2026-12-15 (Dev Patel)
- Joint: technical deep-dive meeting -> target week of 2026-12-06 (Aditya to propose slots)

Thanks — we'll treat this as a prioritized MAP milestone and reflect it in the shared MAP_Draft_v1.pdf.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
snippet: Post-call MAP follow-up discussing PHI/PII handling, retention, audit exports, BAA and proposed milestones / owners.
